source: Pew Research Center (Pew Hispanic Center and Pew Forum on Religion & Public Life). "Changing Faiths: Latinos and the Transformation of American Religion," survey of 4,016 U.S. Hispanic adults, fielded Aug. 10-Oct. 4, 2006.
method: Population is Hispanic adults currently belonging to each religious group (the survey's own recoded 'relig' variable). Share answering "Yes" (vs. "No") to qn25, "Would you describe yourself as a born-again or evangelical Christian, or not?"; don't know/refused excluded from each row's denominator. Groups under 30 valid respondents omitted. Weighted by the dataset's own newweight variable, which corrects for a deliberate oversample of 2,000 non-Catholic respondents.
